elements.name: Way of the Open Hand
elements.desc: Masters of martial arts combat who manipulate their enemy’s ki.

elements.name: Draconic Bloodline
elements.desc: Your innate magic comes from draconic magic in your blood.

elements.name: The Fiend
elements.desc: You have made a pact with a fiend from the lower planes.

elements.name: School of Evocation
elements.desc: You focus on magic that creates powerful elemental effects.

elements.name: Open Hand Technique
elements.desc: When you hit with Flurry of Blows you can push, knock prone or deny reactions

elements.name: Wholeness of Body
elements.desc: Action: regain hit points equal to three times your monk level, once per long rest

elements.name: Tranquility
elements.desc: At the end of a long rest, gain the effect of sanctuary until your next long rest

elements.name: Quivering Palm
elements.desc: When you hit with an unarmed strike, spend 3 ki to start lethal vibrations in the target

elements.name: Dragon Ancestor
elements.desc: Choose a dragon type, you speak Draconic and double your proficiency on Charisma checks with dragons

elements.name: Draconic Resilience
elements.desc: Hit point maximum +1 per sorcerer level, and unarmored AC is 13 + Dex modifier

elements.name: Elemental Affinity
elements.desc: Add Charisma modifier to damage of your ancestry type and spend 1 sorcery point for resistance

elements.name: Dragon Wings
elements.desc: Bonus action: sprout wings and gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed

elements.name: Draconic Presence
elements.desc: Spend 5 sorcery points to project an aura of awe or fear

elements.name: Dark One's Blessing
elements.desc: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, gain temporary hit points equal to Charisma modifier + warlock level

elements.name: Dark One's Own Luck
elements.desc: Add a d10 to an ability check or saving throw, once per short rest

elements.name: Fiendish Resilience
elements.desc: Choose a damage type to resist after each short or long rest

elements.name: Hurl Through Hell
elements.desc: When you hit a creature, send it through the lower planes for 10d10 psychic damage

elements.name: Evocation Savant
elements.desc: Halve the gold and time to copy evocation spells into your spellbook

elements.name: Sculpt Spells
elements.desc: Choose creatures to automatically succeed on saves against your evocation spells

elements.name: Potent Cantrip
elements.desc: Targets that save against your damage cantrips still take half damage

elements.name: Empowered Evocation
elements.desc: Add Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of an evocation spell

elements.name: Overchannel
elements.desc: Maximize damage of a 5th-level or lower wizard spell
